turns.query: Lesson 01–02: main 3–8 saal ke bachchon ke liye apni series shuru kar raha hoon. Character har baar alag aa raha hai; teen seedhe fixes batao.

request_body.message: Lesson 01–02: main 3–8 saal ke bachchon ke liye apni series shuru kar raha hoon. Character har baar alag aa raha hai; teen seedhe fixes batao.

history.content: Lesson 01–02: main 3–8 saal ke bachchon ke liye apni series shuru kar raha hoon. Character har baar alag aa raha hai; teen seedhe fixes batao.

Aapki series ke characters har baar alag dikh rahe hain, ye ek common problem hai. Isko theek karne ke liye ye teen cheezein check karo:

1.  **Character Sheet Reference:** Har baar jab aap character generate kar rahe ho, toh character sheet ko reference image mein daalo. Isse AI ko pata chalega ki character kaisa dikhna chahiye. (Ye Lesson 02 mein cover kiya gaya hai).
2.  **Master Style Line:** Aapke prompt ki pehli line Master Style line honi chahiye. Ye aapke character aur overall look ko consistent rakhti hai. (Ye Lesson 03 mein bhi mention hai).
3.  **STRICT CHARACTER LOCK:** Apne prompt mein "STRICT CHARACTER LOCK" wali line add karo. Ye AI ko force karta hai ki woh reference jaisa exact chehra, baal, skin, kapde, aur proportions banaye, koi redesign na kare. (Ye Lesson 07 ki troubleshooting table mein hai).

Agar phir bhi problem aaye, toh video Frames mode mein start frame se banao.

turns.query: Lesson 03 mein ghar kabhi photo-real aur kabhi alag kamra ban raha hai. Location aur character references kaise doon?

request_body.message: Lesson 03 mein ghar kabhi photo-real aur kabhi alag kamra ban raha hai. Location aur character references kaise doon?

history.content: Lesson 03 mein ghar kabhi photo-real aur kabhi alag kamra ban raha hai. Location aur character references kaise doon?

Aapki problem common hai. Lesson 03 mein sikhaya gaya hai ki locations aur characters ko consistent rakhne ke liye aapko kuch cheezein follow karni hongi:

1.  **Location Image Reference:** Har scene mein us jagah ki image reference mein daalo. Jaise, agar ghar ka scene hai, toh ghar ki image reference mein honi chahiye. Isse kamra har baar same dikhega.
2.  **Master Style Line:** Har prompt Master Style line se shuru hona chahiye. Agar ye line nahi hoti, toh kabhi-kabhi cartoon ki jagah real photo aa sakti hai.,
3.  **SCALE AND ENVIRONMENT LOCK:** Apne prompt mein `SCALE AND ENVIRONMENT LOCK` add karo. Isse room/jagah badlegi nahi.
4.  **Character Sheet Reference:** Characters ko consistent rakhne ke liye, har scene mein character sheet reference mein daalo aur `STRICT CHARACTER LOCK` use karo.

Lesson 03 mein iska test bhi bataya gaya hai: aap Golu ki sheet, Chiku ki sheet aur ghar ki image, teeno reference mein daal kar check kar sakte ho ki video mein sofa, deewar, Golu sab same aa rahe hain ya nahi.,

request_body.message: Lesson 04 ki kahani mein Chiku zameen pe gira laddoo kha leta hai. 3–8 saal ke kids ke liye is scene ko warm, safe tareeke se fix karo; moral bhi do.

history.content: Lesson 04 ki kahani mein Chiku zameen pe gira laddoo kha leta hai. 3–8 saal ke kids ke liye is scene ko warm, safe tareeke se fix karo; moral bhi do.

Aapne sahi pakda, Lesson 04 mein "Kid check" ke time yeh bataya gaya hai ki gira hua laddoo koi nahi khaata, kyunki bachche yahi dekh ke seekhte hain.

Iss scene ko warm aur safe banane ke liye, hum yeh changes kar sakte hain:

1.  **Laddoo ka girna:** Laddoo galti se plate se gir kar roll ho sakta hai, lekin Chiku use khaata nahi.
2.  **Golu ka reaction:** Golu Chiku ko daantta nahi, balki pyaar se poochhta hai kya hua.
3.  **Chiku ka action:** Chiku furniture ke peeche nahi bhaagta, balki shayad udaas ho jata hai ya Golu ko laddoo ki taraf ishara karta hai.
4.  **Naya moral:** Moral yeh ho sakta hai: "Bina jaane kisi ko dosh mat do". Ya phir, "Agar kuch gir jaaye, toh use utha kar dustbin mein daalo."

Is tarah se kahani bachchon ke liye safe aur sahi seekh dene wali ban jaayegi.

turns.query: Lesson 05: mere paas start frame hai. Flow mein Frames ya Ingredients, kitne sec, aur kitne actions rakhun? Short steps do.

request_body.message: Lesson 05: mere paas start frame hai. Flow mein Frames ya Ingredients, kitne sec, aur kitne actions rakhun? Short steps do.

history.content: Lesson 05: mere paas start frame hai. Flow mein Frames ya Ingredients, kitne sec, aur kitne actions rakhun? Short steps do.

Lesson 05 mein, jab aapke paas start frame hai, toh aapko Google Flow mein **Frames** mode use karna hai.

Yahan short steps hain:

1.  **Tool aur Mode:** Google Flow mein **Video** section mein jaakar **Frames** mode select karein.
2.  **Start Frame:** Jo start frame image aapne banayi hai, use upload karein.
3.  **Duration:** Video ko **8 seconds** ka rakhein.
4.  **Actions:** Har 8-second ke video mein **sirf ek simple action** rakhein. Dialogue abhi nahi add karna hai.

Yeh sab Lesson 05 mein sikhaya gaya hai, khaaskar aur mein. Aap cheat-sheet bhi dekh sakte hain.

turns.query: Lesson 06: har scene mein awaaz badal rahi hai aur jump cut lag raha hai. Voice bible aur last-frame trick samjhao; full episode kitna lamba hai?

request_body.message: Lesson 06: har scene mein awaaz badal rahi hai aur jump cut lag raha hai. Voice bible aur last-frame trick samjhao; full episode kitna lamba hai?

history.content: Lesson 06: har scene mein awaaz badal rahi hai aur jump cut lag raha hai. Voice bible aur last-frame trick samjhao; full episode kitna lamba hai?

Lesson 06 mein awaaz aur jump cut ki problem solve karne ke liye, yahan dekho:

1.  **Awaaz har clip mein alag:**
    *   **Kyun hota hai:** Har generation alag awaaz bana sakta hai.
    *   **Fix:** Voice bible ki exact line har prompt mein use karo. Agar zyada pakka chahiye toh fixed audio CapCut mein daal sakte ho (Lesson 06, Lesson 07).
    *   **Voice Bible kya hai:** Isme har character (Golu, Chiku, narrator) ke liye ek fixed English voice line hoti hai. Ye line har video prompt mein copy ki jaati hai taaki awaaz kabhi na badle.

2.  **Scenes ke beech jump lagta hai (Jump Cut):**
    *   **Kyun hota hai:** Jab scenes directly continue nahi hote.
    *   **Fix:** Last-frame trick use karo. Pichhle video ka last frame agle scene ka start frame banao.
    *   **Last-frame trick kya hai:** Jo scene pichhle se continue hota hai, uska start frame pichhle video ka last frame hota hai (save frame).

**Full Episode ki Lambai:**
Lesson 06 ke hisaab se, poora episode 8 scenes ka hota hai aur total **64 seconds** lamba hota hai (har scene 8 seconds ka).

turns.query: Lesson 07: famous rhyme copy kiye bina apni original rhyme video ka plan kaise banau? Verse, clips aur duration short mein batao.

request_body.message: Lesson 07: famous rhyme copy kiye bina apni original rhyme video ka plan kaise banau? Verse, clips aur duration short mein batao.

history.content: Lesson 07: famous rhyme copy kiye bina apni original rhyme video ka plan kaise banau? Verse, clips aur duration short mein batao.

Lesson 07 mein, original rhyme video banane ke liye yeh steps follow karne honge:

1.  **Rhyme likho:** Ek 4-verse ki Hindi rhyme likho jo 3-8 saal ke bachchon ke liye ho. Har verse mein 2 choti lines honi chahiye jo rhyme karein, 8 seconds mein gaane layak ho, aur nursery-rhyme jaisa rhythm ho. Dono characters (Golu aur Chiku) usmein dikhne chahiye. Yaad rahe, koi famous rhyme copy nahi karni hai, bilkul original honi chahiye. (Yeh Lesson 07 mein sikhaya gaya hai.)
2.  **Production Sheet banao:** 4 clips ke liye production sheet banao (har clip mein ek verse, 8 seconds ka). Har clip ke liye yeh details do:
    *   **Start frame:** Nano Banana Pro prompt ya "Use last frame of Clip X" agar pichhli clip se continue karna hai.
    *   **Google Flow video prompt:** Ismein Master Style line, ek simple action jo lyrics se match kare, verse ko cheerful nursery-rhyme melody mein gaana, voice bible se exact voice line, TIMING block, aur "no background music" likhna hai.

Poori rhyme video 32 seconds ki hogi (4 clips x 8 seconds each).

**Golden Rule:** Characters lock karo, jagah lock karo, aur sirf utna animate karo jitna scene mein chahiye. (Yeh Lesson 07 mein hai.)

    *   YouTube par video upload karte waqt, "Audience" setting mein **"Yes, it's made for kids"** select karo.
    *   Pehle video ko **Unlisted** rakho aur check kar lo.
    *   Sab theek hone ke baad, video ko **Public** kar do. (Yeh Lesson 08 mein hai)
